findings.title: Executor-wide upload rejection also rejects the legitimate pre-Run sealed profile
findings.trigger: A qualification prepared by the reviewed Host path uploads its runtime profile using executorToken, seals the Artifact with run_id=null and produced_by=ExecutorID, then puts that profile Artifact into Task.input_refs before admission. This leaves uploaded_content(project, principal=executor) as required preparation state even when the Run never dispatched.
findings.effect: preparedRunAbandonmentFootprint counts every uploaded_content row for this executor/project and rejects nonzero. A valid prepared profile therefore blocks abandonment regardless of empty runtime_uploads/artifact_uses/effects/provider footprint. The candidate cannot demonstrate compatibility with the actual preparation path merely by passing a simpler fixture.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind the immutable qualification plan/profile reference to the exact pre-admission Artifact and storage_key/content_hash/byte_size/principal/input reference. Permit only that independently verified preparation upload (and any other explicitly contracted preparation input), while continuing to reject extra/unbound executor uploads and every Run-scoped runtime_upload/artifact-use. Do not remove the upload guard or delete historical profile artifacts.
findings.required_test: Build the focused fixture through the production profile-upload/qualification preparation path with a real sealed pre-Run profile; prove the exact bound preparation upload is accepted and an additional upload, changed storage_key/hash/principal/profile ref, or any Run-scoped upload is rejected. This requested validation was not executed by reviewer.

verified_properties: One transaction holds resourceWriteLock before authentication/revision/state reads and writes; RuntimeCoordinator.dispatchGate uses the same lock. RunAdmitted commits PREPARED->STARTED before StartBridge; abandonment requires PREPARED with empty worker/locator/identity and zero observations. This closes the inspected dispatch/abandon ordering under the existing lock.

Current direct project OWNER/root, trusted verifier, expected Run/Task revisions, exact epoch, expired Run lease, Task active_run_id, qualification marker identity/root and immutable dispatch hash/key are checked before state transition.

runtimeDispatch independently validates manifest digest, dispatch key, project/run/epoch. Candidate checks task/runtime/executor binding. Run and Task become FAILED with retained active_run_id/qualification marker and immutable proof in same transaction.

Migration0024 forbids proof UPDATE/DELETE, forbids any update of a tombstoned dispatch, freezes old Run updates, and prevents Task status leaving FAILED. Recover query excludes tombstones and markUnknown checks under write lock.

Known schema names/columns used by the footprint queries matched the inspected migration definitions for observations, uploads, Artifact uses/proofs, effects and command-queue tables. No confirmed wrong-table/column issue found in this bounded review.

Budget query checks either run_id or qualification-dispatch/<RunID>. Current production reserveQualificationDispatch writes both fields, so its reservation is caught. reserveFixtureDispatch also writes run_id and is caught. No production Task-only BudgetLedgerEntry writer was established by the inspected sources; reviewer does not invent that gap.

ProviderRequests and ActualCost must be nil; FinancialClosed must be false. No RELEASE/COMMIT/RECONCILE, synthetic runtime observation or worker journal is written. Run FAILED releases concurrency accounting but does not assert financial settlement.
